description: Get congressional securities transactions for a specific ticker (newest first, last year by default). Shows which members of Congress reported a purchase or sale, with transaction and filing dates; amounts are disclosed ranges, not exact values, and Asset identifies the filed instrument (such as stock, option, or bond). Use GetMemberTrades for one member's transactions across all tickers.

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of trades to return (default: 50, max: 500, newest first)

offset.description: Number of matching trades to skip before returning rows (default: 0)

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 1 year ago)

ticker.description: Listed security ticker (e.g., AAPL, VOO, MSFT)

transactionType.description: Filter by transaction type: Purchase or Sale; the synonyms Buy/Sell are accepted (defaults to all)

name: GetCongressionalTrades
title: Congressional Trades by Stock
